themes.evidence: Lead the architecture and development of RAG systems combining LLMs
develop AI-powered assistants for technicians diagnosing anomalies in factory/plant/industrial settings
build pipelines to ingest, preprocess, and index large document corpora
design evaluation strategies to measure performance, accuracy, and UX of RAG systems in production
design scalable, privacy-compliant, latency-sensitive LLM applications

archetype_rationale: Day-to-day is core ML/AI engineering: 5+ years ML with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers, fine-tuning open-source models, building production RAG pipelines with vector stores (FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone). The work is architecting and shipping scalable, latency-sensitive LLM systems, not client-facing consulting or analytics.
notes: M.S. or Ph.D. required and 5+ years ML with core RL/decision-modeling — a stiffer research/ML-eng bar than Kanu's analyst-to-agent-builder profile; industrial/sensor/time-series and startup-from-scratch experience are bonuses.
